name: Showcase
description: Uses each newer ability once: its own sound and picture, the save dialog, the call's state, and a line, marks and a card under every message.

commands.name: showcase-file
commands.description: Saves a small text file where you choose

commands.name: showcase-call
commands.description: Reads the call you are in, into the log

commands.name: showcase-list
commands.description: Lists the pictures and sounds the plugin carries, into the log
